title: Defensive overengineering: guards the contract never asked for

body.signal: Type checks, None guards, or exception handlers added for states the function's contract rules out (e.g. rejecting a negative price when the domain is non-negative, per the apply_discount floor).
body.failure_mode: Bloat obscures the two or three real invariants; over-guarded code fails later refactors and hides genuine bugs under layers of noise branches.
body.detection: Compare each guard against the written contract: a guard with no corresponding contract clause or test is a removal candidate.
body.fix_strategy: Strip guards not required by the contract; keep the domain guards the spec names. Gate: golden I/O plus equivalence - the kept guards must still fire.
